name: upwind_v1
frozen: 2026-09-28, user decision, before any operator evaluation of heldout_rich_g
purpose: Exercise the upwind (live U - A) correction. The frozen_v1 fields are at most cubic in u with theta harmonics <= 3, which the 4-point radial Lagrange and 7-point theta stencils reproduce exactly, so interior one-sided reconstructions coincide and the upwind jump vanishes there. These fields have non-polynomial radial profiles, radial degree above 3, theta harmonics 4-6 and eta harmonics 1-2.
wall_data: Neumann fields supply g_N = n.grad_x f from the field itself; Dirichlet generators supply their analytic trace through the accepted lifted rows

field_sources.rich_a: 1 + 0.10 u cos(th) cos(z) + 0.08 sin(pi u^2/2) sin(z) + 0.05 u^4 sin(4 th) cos(2 z + 0.2) + 0.03 u^6 cos(6 th) sin(z)
field_sources.coordinates: z = 2 pi eta / eta_period; every term is a smooth function of (u cos th, u sin th) times eta harmonics (axis-regular)

gate_scope: main, held-out and the regression pair (b1 x e3, gated and reproduced from frozen_v1 campaign 05be9063), both candidates
wall_exterior_contract: recovered Neumann trace (Dirichlet: prescribed trace); wall-face jump zero by construction; not a physical wall-law qualification
gate: headline N-R global L2 order >= 1.8 on both intervals per gated pair and candidate; acceptance decided by the user
disclosure: rich_a and rich_f were evaluated before this freeze in the local outer-region test work/p05n_rich_fields_20260928 (N-R orders 5.2-5.7), so they are main pairs, not held-out. heldout_rich_g has not been evaluated through any operator.
predeclared_expectation: Pointwise operator: O equals R by code identity, so N-R measures the reconstruction and Neumann closure. The live jump is nonzero on interior radial and theta faces. Orders at N32-N64 may be pre-asymptotic (high theta harmonics are under-resolved at N32), well above 2.
